name: Awei P78K 20000mAh PD22.5w portable Fast charging Power bank
description:
6 Months Official Warranty
20,000mAh Battery Capacity, 22.5W Super Charge
LED Display Battery Status
Type-C Input: 5V/3A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5/
Type-A1/2 Output: 4.5/5A, 5V/3A, 9V/2A, 12V/1.5A

Net Weight: 404.6g

30 minutes Huawei P40 Pro 60% SCP 22.5W fast charge 
30 minutes iPhone14 Pro 50% Support for the Phone series 18W-20W fast charge
